nodes.root_cause: ORDER BY first_seen DESC was non-deterministic for preferences created within the same second. Resolved by adding transactional revision_number column and ordering by revision_number DESC.
nodes.corrective_action: Implemented revision_number INTEGER column with transactional BEGIN IMMEDIATE calculation and ORDER BY revision_number DESC, first_seen DESC, rowid DESC.

nodes.root_cause: Evidence retrieval ordering depended on timestamp tiebreakers.
nodes.corrective_action: Added rowid DESC tiebreaker to get_evidence and revision_number DESC to preference queries.

nodes.root_cause: TruthDependencyTracker used recursive traversal and unordered Python set iteration, causing non-deterministic cycle propagation order dependent on PYTHONHASHSEED and registration order.
nodes.corrective_action: Implemented production-level Tarjan's Strongly Connected Components (SCC) algorithm. Cyclic components compute component_confidence = min(confidences + external_parents) and update atomically.

nodes.root_cause: Missing 'import os' in scheduler.py caused NameError during GoalHierarchy sync, leading to infinite retry loops.
nodes.corrective_action: Added import os, monotonic deadline enforcement in TaskScheduler.run_graph, structured phase timings, and timeout response handling in ECLCoordinator.

nodes.root_cause: Multi-threaded test runner contention during 5-iteration statistical benchmark calculation. Replaced system TEMP dirs with central runtime_paths.get_sandbox_root authority.
nodes.corrective_action: Centralized all sandbox paths under runtime_paths authority and guaranteed directory cleanup via shutil.rmtree.

nodes.root_cause: Benchmark variance calculation contention under parallel test load.
nodes.corrective_action: Centralized runtime_paths authority and isolated project-local sandbox execution.
